review_description: Pinnacle Solar and Batter Installation:From the word go, Sargon was very clear and informative about all the questions we had about the solar installation. Excellent communication and worked to complete the job on time, despite some issues with weather particularly some fairly strong winds. Sargon went above and beyond to keep to the schedule.  Fantastic job. It is always great to keep it local, because he knows the area and he is always nearby in case of emergency. I would highly recommend his work and will pass his details on to friends and colleagues..

Big thanks to Sargon for such a great job installing our solar system. He showed up right on time, was super friendly, and made the whole process feel easy and stress-free. What really stood out was how helpful and patient he was—he answered every question we had (and we had a lot!), always taking the time to explain things clearly without rushing. You can tell he knows his stuff and really cares about doing the job right. The installation looks great, everything is working perfectly, and it was all done with care and attention to detail. It’s not every day you come across someone who’s this professional and easy to work with. We felt in good hands the whole way through. Thanks again, Sargon—we’re really happy with how everything turned out and appreciate all your hard work
The team took the time to explain the process and best options available. Work was carried out to the highest standard and was efficient.

Sargon from pinnacle solar did a fantastic job at our house. Everything was upfront and explained and as a fellow tradesman one of the neatest installs I’ve ever seen.Could not recommend him highly enough.

We recently installed our solar system with pinnacle solar and highly recommend their services. From the initial quotation through to installation and familiarisation, the entire process was very smooth and efficient.Sargon was very friendly and customer oriented, providing expert advise and helping us throughout the process of the installation as well as with the grid connection and familiarisation of the system.

Pinnacle Solar installed a 10kW system at our home in October 2024, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish.The sales and quoting process was smooth and transparent — no pressure, just honest advice and detailed explanations that helped us choose the best system for our needs. Sargon and his team was punctual, polite, and very tidy. They worked efficiently and showed great respect for our property, leaving everything clean and in perfect order.Customer service was truly a standout. The team was extremely knowledgeable and approachable, guiding us through the post-installation process, including organising the grid connection and showing us how to monitor the system. It’s rare to come across such a seamless and professional service these days.Highly recommend Pinnacle Solar for anyone looking for a stress-free, quality solar installation.

The quoting process was clear and straightforward, with no pressure and honest advice. The team at Pinnacle Solar were polite, arrived on time, and left everything clean and tidy. After the install, the team took the time to show me how to use the system, making the whole experience stress free. Truly exceeded my expectations!

From first contact re quote to installation Sargon was very professional, polite and very helpful. Down to removing all rubbish left from installation and assisting with downloading necessary apps. I have no hesitation in recommending if you are thinking of getting Solar. Great work Sargon.
